title: Cataclysm 0.8 · BoRHeZ Games
prompt: CATACLYSM FULL REVIEW / ROADMAP HANDOFF — not a five-item summary. The private video attached by evidence_drive_file_id is the primary source of player feedback. Read its COMPLETE transcript and visual observations through the authenticated private playback stage. Also read game_factory/CATACLYSM_1_0_ROADMAP.md and the existing game code; build a comprehensive issue/idea ledger, reconcile existing implemented systems, identify feature dependencies and propose an ambitious but coherent multi-subsystem release. Preserve working mobile controls and prior progress. Implement multiple compatible gameplay systems when executable tests support them; defer other evidence-backed ideas to the roadmap. Do not use the earlier short triage note as a substitute for the recording. Preserve private user speech outside public artifacts.
acceptance: Private original recording is consumed, including its complete available transcript.
Council uses evidence and current code to select compatible meaningful gameplay systems.
Playable changes pass the independent mobile controls and progression tests.
Unimplemented ideas and uncertainties remain tracked for subsequent releases.
